facts.fact: Data Commissioner Immaculate Kasait issued a final determination in ODPC Complaint No. 1951 of 2024.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

facts.fact: The ODPC found Platinum Credit in breach of the Data Protection Act, 2019 for unlawful processing and failing to obtain consent.
The ODPC ordered Platinum Credit Limited to pay KES 400,000 and issued an enforcement notice under the Data Protection Act, 2019.
